question: What is the room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of Professor Summer Haynes's office?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "employee_directory" AS SELECT "directory_full_name" AS "full_name", "first_name" AS "first_name", "last_name" AS "last_name", "office_location" AS "office_location", "directory_title" AS "directory_title", "primary_title" AS "primary_title" FROM beaver."employee_directory";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "drupal_employee_directory" AS SELECT "full_name" AS "full_name", "first_name" AS "first_name", "last_name" AS "last_name", "office_location" AS "office_location", "primary_title" AS "primary_title" FROM beaver."drupal_employee_directory";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fclt_rooms" AS SELECT "building_room" AS "building_room", "fclt_building_key" AS "fclt_building_key", "floor" AS "floor", "room" AS "room", "room_full_name" AS "room_full_name" FROM beaver."fclt_rooms";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings" AS SELECT "building_key" AS "building_key", "building_number" AS "building_number", "building_street_address" AS "building_street_address" FROM beaver."buildings";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fclt_building_address" AS SELECT "fclt_building_key" AS "fclt_building_key", "building_number" AS "building_number", "street_number" AS "street_number", "street_number_suffix" AS "street_number_suffix", "pre_directional" AS "pre_directional", "street_name" AS "street_name", "street_suffix" AS "street_suffix", "post_directional" AS "post_directional", "city" AS "city", "state" AS "state", "postal_code" AS "postal_code" FROM beaver."fclt_building_address";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
    WITH room_match AS (
      SELECT fr.fclt_building_key AS building_key,
             fr.floor AS floor,
             fr.room AS room,
             fr.building_room
      FROM fclt_rooms fr
      WHERE fr.building_room = '46-299d'
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    addr AS (
      SELECT
        a.fclt_building_key AS building_key,
        a.city,
        a.state,
        CAST(a.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
        TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ',
            NULLIF(a.street_number,''),
            NULLIF(a.street_number_suffix,''),
            NULLIF(a.pre_directional,''),
            NULLIF(a.street_name,''),
            NULLIF(a.street_suffix,''),
            NULLIF(a.post_directional,'')
        )) AS street_address
      FROM fclt_building_address a
    ),
    bldg_fallback AS (
      SELECT building_key, building_street_address FROM buildings
    )
    SELECT
      'Haynes, Summer' AS full_name,
      rm.room AS room,
      rm.floor AS floor,
      rm.building_key AS building_key,
      COALESCE(ad.street_address, bf.building_street_address) AS building_street_address,
      ad.city,
      ad.state,
      ad.postal_code
    FROM room_match rm
    LEFT JOIN addr ad ON ad.building_key = rm.building_key
    LEFT JOIN bldg_fallback bf ON bf.building_key = rm.building_key

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS

WITH person AS (
  SELECT full_name, office_location
  FROM (
    SELECT full_name, office_location FROM employee_directory
    WHERE UPPER(first_name)='SUMMER' AND UPPER(last_name)='HAYNES'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT full_name, office_location FROM drupal_employee_directory
    WHERE UPPER(first_name)='SUMMER' AND UPPER(last_name)='HAYNES'
  ) s
  WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(office_location)<>''
  LIMIT 1
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT
    full_name,
    TRIM(office_location) AS office_location_raw,
    UPPER(REPLACE(TRIM(office_location),' ',' ')) AS office_loc_up
  FROM person
),
parts AS (
  SELECT
    full_name,
    office_location_raw,
    office_loc_up,
    SPLIT_PART(office_loc_up,'-',1) AS bnum,
    NULLIF(SPLIT_PART(office_loc_up,'-',2),'') AS room_part
  FROM normalized
),
variants AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN room_part IS NOT NULL THEN bnum||'-'||room_part ELSE office_loc_up END AS candidate1,
    -- Also try removing internal spaces from room part
    CASE WHEN room_part IS NOT NULL THEN bnum||'-'||REPLACE(room_part,' ','') ELSE office_loc_up END AS candidate2
  FROM parts
),
room_match AS (
  SELECT fr.fclt_building_key AS building_key,
         fr.floor,
         fr.room,
         fr.building_room,
         v.full_name
  FROM variants v
  JOIN fclt_rooms fr
    ON UPPER(fr.building_room) IN (v.candidate1, v.candidate2)
  LIMIT 1
),
addr AS (
  SELECT
    a.fclt_building_key AS building_key,
    a.city,
    a.state,
    CAST(a.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
    TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ',
        NULLIF(a.street_number,''),
        NULLIF(a.street_number_suffix,''),
        NULLIF(a.pre_directional,''),
        NULLIF(a.street_name,''),
        NULLIF(a.street_suffix,''),
        NULLIF(a.post_directional,'')
    )) AS street_address
  FROM fclt_building_address a
),
blg AS (
  SELECT building_key, building_street_address FROM buildings
)
SELECT
  rm.full_name,
  rm.room,
  rm.floor,
  rm.building_key,
  COALESCE(ad.street_address, bl.building_street_address) AS building_street_address,
  ad.city,
  ad.state,
  ad.postal_code
FROM room_match rm
LEFT JOIN addr ad ON ad.building_key = rm.building_key
LEFT JOIN blg bl ON bl.building_key = rm.building_key

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT full_name, room, floor, building_key, building_street_address, city, state, postal_code
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM (
      -- Re-run the robust SQL to ensure determinism
      WITH person AS (
        SELECT full_name, office_location
        FROM (
          SELECT full_name, office_location FROM employee_directory
          WHERE UPPER(first_name)='SUMMER' AND UPPER(last_name)='HAYNES'
          UNION ALL
          SELECT full_name, office_location FROM drupal_employee_directory
          WHERE UPPER(first_name)='SUMMER' AND UPPER(last_name)='HAYNES'
        ) s
        WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(office_location)<>''
        LIMIT 1
      ),
      normalized AS (
        SELECT full_name,
               TRIM(office_location) AS office_location_raw,
               UPPER(REPLACE(TRIM(office_location),' ',' ')) AS office_loc_up
        FROM person
      ),
      parts AS (
        SELECT full_name, office_location_raw, office_loc_up,
               SPLIT_PART(office_loc_up,'-',1) AS bnum,
               NULLIF(SPLIT_PART(office_loc_up,'-',2),'') AS room_part
        FROM normalized
      ),
      variants AS (
        SELECT *,
               CASE WHEN room_part IS NOT NULL THEN bnum||'-'||room_part ELSE office_loc_up END AS candidate1,
               CASE WHEN room_part IS NOT NULL THEN bnum||'-'||REPLACE(room_part,' ','') ELSE office_loc_up END AS candidate2
        FROM parts
      ),
      room_match AS (
        SELECT fr.fclt_building_key AS building_key,
               fr.floor,
               fr.room,
               fr.building_room,
               v.full_name
        FROM variants v
        JOIN fclt_rooms fr
          ON UPPER(fr.building_room) IN (v.candidate1, v.candidate2)
      ),
      addr AS (
        SELECT a.fclt_building_key AS building_key,
               a.city,
               a.state,
               CAST(a.postal_code AS VARCHAR) AS postal_code,
               TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ',
                   NULLIF(a.street_number,''),
                   NULLIF(a.street_number_suffix,''),
                   NULLIF(a.pre_directional,''),
                   NULLIF(a.street_name,''),
                   NULLIF(a.street_suffix,''),
                   NULLIF(a.post_directional,''))) AS street_address
        FROM fclt_building_address a
      ),
      blg AS (
        SELECT building_key, building_street_address FROM buildings
      )
      SELECT rm.full_name,
             rm.room,
             rm.floor,
             rm.building_key,
             COALESCE(ad.street_address, bl.building_street_address) AS building_street_address,
             ad.city,
             ad.state,
             ad.postal_code
      FROM room_match rm
      LEFT JOIN addr ad ON ad.building_key = rm.building_key
      LEFT JOIN blg bl ON bl.building_key = rm.building_key
    )
  )
)
SELECT * FROM base
LIMIT 1
